result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives an effective pro-rata refund of prepaid post-termination fees, and Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. However, stating that Customer has “no further payment obligation for the terminated Services” may unintentionally waive accrued but unpaid fees and goes beyond the required position. The rights to terminate “in part” and to terminate part of the Agreement also add unnecessary scope and some ambiguity. The clause should instead preserve amounts accrued through the effective termination date.
